thread:
mariana: FYI a customer (acct: acct_53921) says the promo code 'WELCOME50' fails via API with a 400 coupon_invalid, but the promo appears active in the dashboard. attaching repro steps.

mariana: Repro:
```
POST /v1/checkout/redeem
body: {"code":"WELCOME50", "account_id":"acct_53921"}
Response: 400 {"error":"coupon_invalid", "message":"Promo code invalid or expired", "code":"PROMO_INVALID"}
```

mike_support: Can you DM me the account email and the exact string the customer pasted? Also did they try the dashboard redemption or only our API?

mariana: Sent DM. They tried both. In the dashboard the code shows up and redeem input seems to accept it when pasted from the UI, but the same visible code pasted into the API checkout fails. Tried browser/devices, same result.

olivia_dev: I'll grep coupon-service logs for the account and code. Give me a minute.

sanjay_infra: quick thought: we rolled a sanitizer tweak last week that only strips ASCII spaces. If the DB stored the code with a non-breaking space or other unicode whitespace, validation path might not match. Worth checking the actual DB value.

olivia_dev: Found row: promo id pc_9223. DB shows code = 'WELCOME\u00A050' (i.e. contains U+00A0 NBSP). expires_at = 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z, redeem_count = 0.

mariana: That would explain it — dashboard copy flow normalizes the code, but when a user types a normal space or the API validation expects ASCII, the lookup fails because the stored string has NBSP.

mike_support: Short-term remediation? Customer is blocked on checkout.

olivia_dev: Options: 1) Manually grant the credit to acct_53921 right now. 2) Hotfix validator to normalize unicode whitespace (map all unicode space class to U+0020) and deploy to canary. 3) Run a DB migration to clean existing codes. I'll do a canary for the validator so the customer can redeem immediately.

sanjay_infra: I'll prepare a one-off normalization SQL: update promo_codes set code = regexp_replace(code, '\\s+', ' ', 'g') where code ~ '\\p{Z}'; also add a test suite for unicode whitespace. Schedule during low traffic window.

mike_support: Please do the manual grant while the hotfix rolls, customer needs cashflow.

olivia_dev: deploy_bot: starting canary deploy for coupon-validator (userfix/unicode-space-normalize) to us-west-canary.
deploy_bot: canary deploy successful, health checks passing.

olivia_dev: Verified on canary:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout/redeem -d '{"code":"WELCOME50","account_id":"acct_53921"}'
-> 200 {"status":"redeemed","promo_id":"pc_9223","credit":50}
```

mariana: Customer confirmed credits applied, checkout went through. :thumbsup:

mike_support: Good. Promote the validator fix to prod and run the DB normalization during the scheduled maintenance. Also add monitoring to flag promo codes containing non-ascii whitespace.

sanjay_infra: Migration scheduled for 2025-03-22 02:00 UTC, will replace NBSP and other unicode spaces with U+0020 and add a verification report. Adding a monitor rule to alert if any codes contain \u00A0 or other Zs chars. Raising RFC for improving ingest validation.

olivia_dev: Patch promoted to prod; added unit tests for all unicode space characters in coupon-validator repo. Leaving thread open until migration completes.

mariana: Thanks all — customer unblocked and happy. Will file a short post-mortem with links to the migration plan and the PRs.
